hooks.name: Aikido Scan on Write
hooks.description:
Runs an Aikido security scan after any file is written or modified

Migration note: Tool categories were converted to the tool-name matcher `^(fs_write|fs_append|str_replace|delete_file|code)$`, reconstructed from the built-in tool list. Confirm it covers the tools you meant, then enable the hook.

action.prompt: A file was just written or modified. Activate the aikido-kiro-power and run aikido_full_scan on all files that were created or modified in this session. Fix any findings and rescan to verify.
